text:
alex nguyen: Heads up — oncall asked for a short-term SIEM export to support vuln triage. Need clarity on retention, KMS unwrap, RBAC, and revoke. Proposal: 48h encrypted snapshot with JIT access. Who's ok with that?

mira patel: Quick q — do we already have a JIT unwrap flow for delivered artifacts? We use kms-proxy for ad-hoc queries but not for exported blobs.

sam o'connor: We don't currently unwrap for delivered files. Suggest: keep export encrypted with an envelope key and generate an ephemeral KEK per-export. Unwrap only via a JIT API that checks role + ticket. That way objects at rest are useless.

jess (oncall): From a triage POV we need fast access. If we grant 48h access, what's the exact revoke path? Can we auto-expire?

alex nguyen: Draft flow: 1) Create a timeboxed role "siem-export-viewer" (48h) enforced by OPA + SCIM provisioning 2) Exports written to s3://redwood-siem/jit-exports/<export-id>.enc using envelope encryption 3) KMS unwrap only via kms-proxy when role is active + ticket validated 4) All unwrap events emit audit log + Slack notif 5) Revoke = deactivate role + rotate ephemeral KEK (makes stored .enc unreadable)

mira patel: Who is responsible for rotating KEKs on revoke? Ops or security? Need a documented runbook and a one-click revoke option for oncall.

sam o'connor: Ops can rotate ephemeral KEKs via the key-service API. Caveat: rotation doesn't remove decrypted copies analysts may have pulled. Recommend a view-proxy that streams decrypted content to a sandbox with no disk persistence, rather than handing down files.

ops-bot: Incident created: INC-2026-112 — SIEM export / JIT access request. Link: https://tickets.redwood.ai/INC-2026-112. Assigned: sam o'connor, mira patel.

jess (oncall): Also need rules for size and PII. We sometimes need PCAPs; legal may ask for longer retention for investigations. 48h seems fine for routine triage but we need an escalation path for forensics.

mira patel: Agreed. Add DLP scrub step in export pipeline (mask emails, partial IP redaction) and an export tag "forensics-flag" that requires sec approval to extend retention beyond 48h.

alex nguyen: Action items: - sam: prototype view-proxy (stream-only, no writes) - mira: draft RBAC policy, DLP rules, and approval flow - ops: wire ephemeral KEK rotation + one-click revoke UI I'll combine into a playbook for the oncall runbook and link the ticket.

sam o'connor: I'll push a PoC container that streams a decrypted tarball to stdout and refuses writes. Will open PR and link to INC-2026-112 in a few hours.

mira patel: I'll draft a request checklist: ticket link, justification, duration, DLP level, export id, approver. Must be attached to ticket for audit trail.

alex nguyen: +1. If no objections to 48h cap by EOD, we'll roll the initial flow into staging. If anyone has regulatory concerns (longer retention or evidence handling), flag now so we can include legal. :thumbsup:
